📋 Important Rules

⚠️ SEPTIC SYSTEM
This home has a very sensitive septic system. Only human waste and toilet paper may go down the toilet. Nothing else (wipes, paper towels, hygiene products, etc.).
  • Quiet hours: 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM (Gualala ordinance). Max 55 dBA.
  • Parking: Maximum 3 cars. Extra vehicles can park at the office lot: 39225 Suite B South Hwy 1, Gualala.
  • Trash day: Tuesday — bring bags to the end of the driveway by the highway.
  • No parties or events.
  • No smoking of any substance anywhere on the property.
  • Pets are allowed (up to 2 under 30 lbs — pet fee applies).

🛁 Outdoor Amenities

Hot tub, gas grill, fire pit & lounge seating with ocean views

  • Hot Tub – Please shower before use and close the cover when finished.
  • Barrel Sauna – Allow time to heat. Use a towel on the bench.
  • Outdoor Fireplace / Fire Pit – Only burn provided firewood. Fully extinguish before leaving unattended.
  • Gas Grill – Available on the deck for outdoor cooking.

Please minimize exterior lighting at night out of respect for the dark-sky coastal community.

🏋️ Fitness Studio / Gym

Separate building across the driveway — full gym with ocean views

  • The gym is located in its own building across the driveway from the main house.
  • Please wipe down equipment after use.
  • Return all equipment (weights, mats, benches, etc.) to its starting location when you finish.
  • Leave the space clean and ready for the next guest.
  • Kitchenette available for post-workout refuels.

🏠 How Things Work

Indoor Fireplace (Gas)

Normal use (remote):

  • Screen shows ON/OFF in upper right. Number on left is room temperature.
  • Press Mode until it shows ON, then use up/down arrows to set desired room temp.
  • Fireplace turns off automatically when room reaches the set temperature.
  • To turn off manually: press Mode twice.

If remote doesn’t work:

  • Replace AAA batteries (spares in living room closet).
  • Manual lighting: Remove protective screen → find ON/PILOT/OFF knob (left) and ignition button (right) → push knob to PILOT, hold and press ignition until blue pilot lights → hold 30 seconds → slowly turn to ON.
SONOS Sound System
Connect your phone to the Wi-Fi → open your music app → select the desired SONOS speaker(s) under connected devices. For advanced control, download the free SONOS app.
Heat (Upstairs Bedrooms)
Both upstairs bedrooms have in-wall heaters controlled by smart thermostats on the wall. The heater turns on when the room temperature drops below the set temperature.
Smart TVs
Please use your own Netflix / Hulu / streaming logins and log out before departure. Failure to log out may result in a maintenance fee.
Power Outages
This home has a generator. Four lanterns are provided. Check pge.com for outage status. No compensation is provided for PG&E outages.

🦝 Wildlife & Windows

Important: This is a rural coastal area. Raccoons and other wildlife are common.
Always close and lock all windows and doors at night (and when leaving). Open/unlocked windows can allow animals inside and may result in guest charges for damage.

🚪 Checkout Checklist (by 10:00 AM)

  • Double-check you have all personal belongings
  • Lock all windows and doors (very important!)
  • Load and run the dishwasher
  • Place all used towels in the bathtub (do not put them in the washer — linens are outsourced)
  • Bag trash and place in outdoor receptacle, then take to the end of the driveway
  • Turn off all lights

Housekeepers arrive at 10:00 AM. Late checkout must be pre-approved.
